agfa_vista_100.note: The brochure states no read density; 1.0 above D-min is used (inferred).

fuji_eterna_500.note: No ETERNA 500 value found; Fujifilm describes its granularity as similar to EI 250 films. The value of F-250 (inferred).

fuji_eterna_500_vivid.note: No ETERNA VIVID 500 value found; the value of F-250, as for ETERNA 500 (inferred).

fuji_natura_1600.note: The Japanese NATURA 1600 sheet has no text layer; the value of SUPERIA 1600 (inferred: the same emulsion family).

kodak_5247.note: The sheet gives 'less than 5'; the bound 5 is used (inferred).

kodak_5247_II.note: No sheet found; the value of 5247 (inferred).

kodak_5248.note: Product code 5248; the only 5248 chart in the sources is the EXR 100T chart (inferred).

kodak_5250.note: No sheet found; the value of the Kodak tungsten camera negative 5247 (inferred).
